einzeiler: Experts warn of a record-breaking El Niño and look back at Steve Irwin's legacy.
kurzfassung: The World Meteorological Organisation warns that an upcoming El Niño event could be the strongest in over 70 years, driving extreme global temperatures and weather patterns. Meanwhile, mental health professionals increasingly rely on AI tools for administrative tasks, raising questions about data confidentiality and regulatory gaps. Additionally, two decades after his death, friends and colleagues reflect on the enduring conservation legacy of Steve Irwin.
stichpunkte: The UN warns of a super-sized El Niño that could become the strongest in over 70 years.
Pacific Ocean surface temperatures and deeper layers show unprecedented warming.
Australia deploys a search and rescue team to Nepal following catastrophic floods.
Economic discussions highlight Australia's productivity challenges and barriers to older workers.
Mental health clinicians widely adopt AI tools, though patient confidentiality and guidelines remain controversial.
Tasmanian local councils raise concerns over energy-guzzling AI data centres straining the power grid.
Colleagues and family mark 20 years since the death of television personality and conservationist Steve Irwin.

clips.text: A climate researcher notes that underwater temperatures measured ten degrees higher than normal levels, calling the readings extraordinary.

clips.hook: Do older workers face penalties for staying on the job?
clips.text: The discussion examines whether individuals above retirement age should be allowed to keep their full government support while paying a flat tax rate.

clips.hook: The majority of mental health clinicians use artificial intelligence weekly
clips.text: Survey results indicate that most practitioners utilize digital assistance regularly, with a significant portion transcribing patient sessions every single day.

clips.hook: Working side-by-side with the ultimate wildlife hero
clips.text: A close associate recalls meeting his idol as a teenager before eventually taking on leadership roles at the zoological park.

beschreibung: Experts say the world is facing a "super-sized" El Niño event -- that could be the strongest in more than 70 years.
